# ReAlto Partners

> ReAlto Partners is a culture-first organization of real estate agents at eXp Realty, founded and led by Dan Gomer and based in Highlands Ranch in the Denver metro area of Colorado. Tagline: "Empowering People Through Real Estate." It is a real estate team, not a brokerage (eXp Realty is the brokerage) and not related to any private equity firm named Alto Partners.

Key facts:
- Founder and team leader: Dan Gomer, a former middle school science teacher and basketball coach, real estate investor since starting with fix and flips in Denver, in real estate since 2012, with eXp Realty since 2022, and author of "I'm Full of It and So Are You."
- Partner and podcast co-host: Allison Gomer, Dan's wife, a Colorado psychotherapist and ceremonial guide who offers cacao ceremonies, guided meditation and a nine-session Sacred Psychotherapy and Ceremony program (allisongomer.com).
- Mission: positively impact as many lives as possible using the vehicle of real estate.
- Vision: personal and financial freedom for every agent partner.
- Core values: culture is our heartbeat; service is the path to success; resourcefulness and resiliency; integrity in all actions; community and dependability.
- Weekly rhythm: Crush the Cap call Wednesdays 9:00 AM Mountain, team call Wednesdays 9:30 AM Mountain.
- Community: breakfasts and happy hours, quarterly charity events, masterminds, eXp Explained luncheons in Colorado Springs, an annual camping trip and an annual golf tournament.
- Areas served: Denver, Highlands Ranch, Douglas County, Colorado Springs and Colorado's Front Range; agents can join from anywhere eXp Realty operates.
- Phone: 303.261.5278
- Podcast: The Dan & Allison Gomer Podcast (now recording) on business, marriage, leadership, mindset, money, real estate and wellbeing.
- eXp Realty programs (revenue share, stock awards, splits and caps) are set by eXp Realty and change over time; earnings are not guaranteed.
